title: boardsmith.json
description: Single source of truth for the set of top-level keys a boardsmith.json project config may legitimately carry. `src/cli/lib/config-schema.ts` derives ALLOWED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS from `Object.keys(properties)` below, and `boardsmith validate` / `boardsmith dev` startup use that list to reject unknown/misspelled keys with a did-you-mean suggestion. Do NOT add a key here unless it has a real read site: either a command in src/cli/commands consumes it (see the file:line trace in 135-05-PLAN.md's read_first), or the PUBLISHING PLATFORM consumes it out of the manifest that build.ts's deriveManifest produces by spreading this config. The platform's own manifest allowlist is ShufflewickPub `games/src/manifest-schema.ts` — a key it does not accept must not be listed here, or the failure moves from author time to publish time, which is the exact bug the platform-consumed keys below were added to fix.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema reference (point it at this file's $id for IDE autocomplete/validation). Ignored by the CLI — this is the one key exempt from the read-site rule above, because the schema itself can only be consumed through it.

audience.description: Who the game is for — exactly one platform shelf. The canonical value list lives on the platform (GET /api/taxonomy); `boardsmith publish` preflight-validates against it. Scaffold-emitted; shape-checked by validate.ts.

tags.description: Freeform discovery tags (mechanisms, themes, eras) — e.g. 'abstract', 'worker-placement', 'family-friendly'. Normalized server-side. Scaffold-emitted; shape-checked by validate.ts.

playtime.description: Estimated play time range in minutes (min <= max). Scaffold-emitted; shape-checked by validate.ts.

cooperative.description: True when players win or lose together. A structural fact synced to the platform on every publish. Scaffold-emitted; shape-checked by validate.ts.

thumbnail.description: Relative path to the game's thumbnail image. Scaffold-emitted.

gameOptions.description: Game-level option definitions surfaced in the dev host and lobby. Read by dev.ts.

playerOptions.description: Per-player option definitions surfaced in the dev host and lobby. Read by dev.ts.

colorPalette.description: Custom per-player color choices. Read by dev.ts.

paths.description: Optional overrides for the rules/ui source directories (paths.rules, paths.ui). Read by dev.ts, simulate.ts, evolve-ai-weights.ts.

gameId.description: Stable platform game identifier, written back into boardsmith.json by `boardsmith publish` after first publish. Read by publish.ts.

publisher.description: Publisher slug, written back into boardsmith.json by `boardsmith publish` (from --publisher). Read by publish.ts.

publisherId.description: Stable platform publisher identifier, written back into boardsmith.json by `boardsmith publish`. Read by publish.ts.

version.description: Optional manifest version override consumed by build.ts's deriveManifest (defaults to '1.0.0' when absent).

persistence.description: Opt in to the platform's cross-session key/value store. Absent or false means the platform issues no persistence read at game start and no commit at game over. Consumed by the platform (manifest-schema.ts `persistence`).

ai.description: Does this bundle ship an AI (a gameDefinition.ai block)? Lets the platform hand an expired seat to a caretaker bot. Consumed by the platform (manifest-schema.ts `ai`).

joinInProgress.description: May a player join a session that is already underway? Absence is the 'no' answer; only a game whose rules can seat a latecomer (a persistent world, a dormant-seat design) should set it. Consumed by the platform (manifest-schema.ts `joinInProgress`).

idleAction.description: The action the platform submits on behalf of a seat whose round deadline expired, for a game that ships no AI. Required by the platform alongside `roundDeadline` when `ai` is not true. Consumed by the platform (manifest-schema.ts `idleAction`).

defaultHours.description: Used by a table that expresses no preference. Must satisfy minHours <= defaultHours <= maxHours.

minHours.description: Floor a table may choose. The platform's own floor is 1 hour.

maxHours.description: Ceiling a table may choose. The platform's own ceiling is 720 hours (30 days).

mindingSafe.description: The author's explicit acknowledgement that a caretaker bot may play an absent player's seat in THIS game. The platform requires it when `ai: true` resolves an expiry.

roundDeadline.description: How long one round may sit before the platform intervenes. Consumed by the platform (manifest-schema.ts `roundDeadline`), which also enforces its own hour bounds and requires either `ai: true` or an `idleAction` alongside it.

resolveAction.description: The single action one round resolution submits, from the platform's seat, against the stored world snapshot with nobody connected.

enrolAction.description: Optional. The action the platform submits to enrol an arriving player into the world.

world.description: The persistent-world block. Absent on every ordinary game — its absence means 'this game is not a persistent world'. Consumed by the platform (manifest-schema.ts `world`), which REQUIRES resolveAction once the block is present: a world with no resolver can never advance a round.

name.description: The action name, exactly as the game's rules register it.

args.description: Optional literal arguments submitted with the action. Opaque to the platform — what constitutes a legal action is the game's business.

namedAction.description: An action the PLATFORM submits on a game's behalf, named as the game's rules register it.
